set.now: docs written; proving the stack/split toggle and shooting 1280 + 3440
steps: Read the references and answer the layout skill's five questions

links.label: The realm - stacks vs splits, live, then the catalogue
1.* one column - stack, measure, rows, scroll sections
2.* two columns - equal, golden, main+aside, fixed+fluid, fr

set.outcome:
**The numbered layout system lands: two moves, eighteen layouts, every one openable full screen.** [/imagine/layouts/](/imagine/layouts/) opens with the one idea — *a STACK is what a `div` does on its own; a SPLIT divides a fixed or specified area into pieces* — shown live, side by side, with the same three boxes and four chips for HOW a split divides (`%`, fixed, `flex-grow`/`basis`, `fr`).

Then the catalogue: [1.\*](/imagine/layouts/1/) one column (4) · [2.\*](/imagine/layouts/2/) two (5) · [3.\*](/imagine/layouts/3/) three (5) · [4.\*](/imagine/layouts/4/) four or more (4). The number is how many columns at its widest, the word after the dot is how the room is divided, and the url is the same two parts — `2.golden` is [/imagine/layouts/2/golden/](/imagine/layouts/2/golden/).

![the hub at 1280](hub-1280.png)

**Every entry is one 3-column card**, built once as `LayoutsCard` with three static parts: LEFT the name, a two-sentence intro and the chips; CENTRE the layout live in a viewport the reader sets to 400 / 1280 / 1920 / 3440, scaled to fit; RIGHT the CSS it is, the widths its tracks just measured, and the one line of config that makes a page from it. The CSS printed is the object applied to the box, so code and result cannot drift. Four chips — **padding** (tight/default/airy, multiples of the two spacing clamps), **surface** (the five paging surfaces, so colour is permuted WITH layout on one page), **navigation** (none · crumbs · tabs · left rail · right rail · bottom bar) and **viewport**. Nothing is written to storage or the url; a changed card shows a *modified* mark and a reset chip.

![2.* at 3440](three-3440.png)

**Takeover, with a way on.** Every entry has a `full` page carrying a bar that is part of the layout: previous · where you are (7 of 18) · next · back to the number · **hide the crumb strip**. Previous/next walk all 18 across the four numbers, so a reader never leaves full screen. The owner's question is answered on the page: the crumbs are not always there — one class on `<body>` in `@layer util` out-ranks core's own rule, and `deactivated()` clears it so a hidden strip cannot follow you into another realm.

![takeover at 3440, the persistent bar](takeover-3440.png)

**Rows inside columns and scroll sections:** `3.rows-in-columns` (a column split into two rows), `4.quad` (2 x 2, rows of different heights), `3.scroll` (only the centre scrolls, in snapping sections — `scrollHeight` 323 against `clientHeight` 215), plus `1.rows` and `1.sections`. Each says in one sentence when it is the right answer.

![4.quad full screen](quad-full-1280.png)

**Proved.** Zero console errors at 400 / 1280 / 1920 / 3440 on the hub, all four number pages and all 18 full-screen pages; no document overflow, nothing at x:0, no layout overflowing its frame. Chips driven headless: padding 14.4 to 28.8px with the surface class untouched; surface swapped with tracks 259 to 259; nav added a rail; viewport 3440 read 1576px tracks at 18% zoom; reset returned every axis. At 3440 full: card 3342px, intro 356 / stage 2517 / readouts 421; golden 1492/922 = 1.618; main-aside's aside capped at 416px.

**Four defects found and fixed, all silent:** a part named `LayoutsPair` wore `.layouts-pair` (the row it builds) and laid the demo out sideways · the surface chip moved track widths because only `card` had a border · a layout beside a rail needs `flex: 1 1 0` (a percentage against an `auto` basis is circular) · a nested track inherited `.layouts-box`'s centring and made `4.quad`'s four panels four 40px ribbons.

**Left open, with reasons in [doc/decisions.md](/imagine/layouts/doc/decisions.md):** at 1280 inside the columns row the card stacks (the number column is ~610px, the card's floor is 52rem — the same floor a three-track row carries); full screen is where the three columns come back, and a column word that claims the row without `full`'s ancestor collapse is a core columns question, not this realm's. `5.*` is not built: `4.*` is *four or more* on purpose, because the count stops being the useful axis around four. The viewport chip simulates width, not `em` — the one exception `styles/layouts/cols/` already measured.

**Deliverable 2 and 5 are one page, not two.** The brief asked for one page per distribution (2) and a full variant of the catalogue (5); building both would have given every entry two pages showing the same card. The distribution page IS the full-screen page, and the number page is the related scroll of all its distributions. Named here rather than left implicit.

Docs: [readme.md](/imagine/layouts/readme.md) · [doc/decisions.md](/imagine/layouts/doc/decisions.md). `layouts-` added to `styles/css-scopes.txt`. Nothing in `core/`, `ext/`, `styles/layouts/` or `paging/` was touched.
